Overview

Springfield is a city in IL with a population of 115,000. Illinois capital with Abraham Lincoln sites, Route 66 history, and a classic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
